labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: unresectable or metastatic CRC with microsatellite stable status (MSS)
Relapse or progression after 1 prior line of systemic therapy including a fluoropyrimidine plus oxaliplatin
No prior treatment with topoisomerase I inhibitors
performance status of 0 or 1

labels.note: MSS mCRC progressing after 1 line FOLFOX/bev, irinotecan-naive.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Colorectal cancer (CRC).
Participants who have received or been intolerant to treatment with either trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102), regorafenib or fruquintinib.

labels.note: CRC cohort requires prior TAS-102/regorafenib/fruquintinib; patient only had 1 line FOLFOX/bev.

labels.label: not_relevant

evidence.quote: Diagnosis of phenotypic classical FAP

labels.note: Familial adenomatous polyposis trial, not metastatic colon cancer treatment.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: HER2+ disease as determined by a tissue based assay
Participant has rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog wild-type (RAS WT) disease
Prior systemic anticancer therapy for colorectal cancer (CRC) in the locally advanced unresectable or metastatic setting

labels.note: HER2-negative, KRAS-mutant, already treated in metastatic setting.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: CRC, all subtypes
with no satisfactory SOC treatment options available
fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin-, and irinotecan-based chemotherapy

labels.note: CRC cohort needs prior irinotecan; Part A needs no SOC options left. Patient has only had 1 line.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Must have GRPR-positive disease
Colorectal carcinoma
performance status of less than or equal to 1

labels.note: Metastatic CRC fits; GRPR positivity on imaging unknown.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Stage IIB, IIC, or Stage III colon adenocarcinoma with R0 resection
Pathologic, clinical, or radiologic overt evidence of metastatic disease.

labels.note: Adjuvant stage II/III trial; patient has liver metastases.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Patients must be RAS/ RAF WT
No oncogenic missense mutations in KRAS
A microsatellite stable (MSS) tumor.

labels.note: All mCRC cohorts require RAS wild-type; patient is KRAS G12D.
